artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: _whole() added; _muse_fields requires a whole-number version for every action and accepts seq as a whole number or null; MUSE_ACTED and MUSE_ACTED_KEEP added; on_muse_reply computes sha256(payload + newline + signature), refuses replayed when the hash is in state muse_acted, refuses seq-mismatch when a pending that carries a seq does not match the answer's seq, calls on_sms_reply, and records the hash only when the result is in MUSE_ACTED (last 200). No AWS call, no deploy; the change is a code commit on wk-COMM_ASSIST-16 only.

four existing signed-answer tests now name the draft's seq in their signed payloads (the verified send, the edit then drop, the answer for no open draft, the stale signed edit); new tests: a missing or bool version is bad-payload for every action, the same signed bytes replayed are refused replayed and act once, an old answer aimed at a later draft under the same tag is refused replayed or seq-mismatch with the draft untouched, a seq that is absent, null or 99 is seq-mismatch, a seqless pending is not seq-checked for an absent or carried seq, an unseen result records nothing, and the acted record keeps the last 200. Test changes only; the issuer's checks are not edited.
